title: Neodustria Phase 23.5 Blinded Discovery & Hypothesis Revision Results
protocol_controls: Zero prompt hints, zero fallback substitutions, dimensionally invariant groups

blinded_hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Parasitic lateral drift is second-order kinematic foreshortening from inextensible elastica: transverse stroke dy forces axial shortening dx ~ dy^2/L independent of thickness to first order
blinded_hypothesis.physical_mechanism: arc-length conservation of bent flexure blade gives foreshortening proportional to square of transverse deflection divided by length; bending stiffness scales with th^3 but kinematics to leading order is inextensible and thickness-independent

revised_hypothesis.falsification_analysis: Proposed model overpredicted dx by 3.25x (38.69mm vs 11.90mm FEA) at large dy/L=1.606, indicating super-quadratic alpha and/or too large C. Low-force ground truth shows dx scales ~quadratically with dy (points 3-4 same th: dlnPx/dlnPy=2.00) and weak inverse th dependence. Including high-deformation FEA point (same th as point1) gives alpha=1.83, pulling alpha down from ~2 to ~1.9 due to geometric stiffening/saturation at dy/L>1. Th dependence is weak: beta~0.0-0.4, revised to ~0.2 to reconcile cross-thickness points. C recalibrated to ~0.095 to match all 5 points in log-space.

audit_verdict: STRICT_VERIFIED: Dimensionless zero-leakage prompt; Muse revised C from 0.50 to 0.095, reducing held-out prediction error by 83.9% (1.434 mm -> 0.2307 mm RMSE), outperforming Gaussian Process (0.5315 mm).
modes_supported: --replay (exact authentic responses recomputed on fresh FEA surface)
